title: Spiritual Partnership vs Marriage
fullTitle: Soul Feast #19: Spiritual Partnership vs Marriage
description: In this illuminating Soul Feast, Gary explores the profound differences between traditional marriage and the emerging new relationship called spiritual partnership.
Gary introduces spiritual partnership as a new archetype designed for this transformative era, offering a deeper, more meaningful way to connect .

Traditional marriage, Gary explains, stems from the five-sensory consciousness rooted in roles and external power dynamics. These relationships are based on control and ownership, with terms like “husband” and “wife” reflecting outdated constructs.
In contrast, spiritual partnerships are grounded in equality, creating authentic power, and a shared commitment to spiritual growth.

The key to embracing spiritual partnership lies in creating authentic power by aligning the personality with the soul. This means challenging fear, nurturing love, and choosing conscious actions that foster connection and joy.
